tender.title: UoD-EFM034-TC-2026 - Water Hygiene Monitoring
tender.description:
Estates & Campus Services are required to re-tender the Monitoring, servicing and reactive maintenance contract.  We are seeking another reputable Water hygiene monitoring accredited supplier with a proven record of water hygiene monitoring of domestic and commercial domestic water systems.
The aims and objectives of this contract are to ensure the continuing safety of staff, student's & visitors of the University and the wider public.
This maintenance service is delivered across the University`s Estate comprising the City Centre campus as well as other outlying properties.  All properties are located within the Dundee City boundary.  These properties include an extensive variety of operational data centre and research facilities, teaching facilities, sport facilities and horticultural facilities.
The University believes the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006 (TUPE) may apply to this contract. Tenderers should allow for the transfer of one (1) staff member currently engaged in delivering the water hygiene operational control regime, subject to confirmation through the procurement process. An anonymised TUPE/Employee Liability Information schedule will be provided separately (where applicable). Tenderers must confirm their approach to TUPE, including mobilisation, management arrangements, and integration of the transferring employee into service delivery.

tender.title: Smoking Cessation Workplace Outreach
tender.description:
This tender is being run as a Competitive Process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.
Smoking remains a leading cause of preventable illness and premature death. Employees in routine and manual occupations in Wolverhampton have a significantly higher smoking prevalence, compared to the general population. The aim of this service is to support to successfully quit smoking through a structured, evidence-based cessation programme. 
The workplace outreach smoking cessation delivery will recruit staff to deliver evidence-based services for adult smokers working in routine and manual occupations to stop smoking. In local workplaces, the service will provide information, advice, and guidance; self-help tools; and lifestyle interventions to enable Service Users to achieve and maintain positive lifestyle changes.

lots.description:
The service will support Wolverhampton's Primary Care Framework 2026/27 (PCF)  (formally QOF+) specifically: Reduce the number of smokers in Wolverhampton.
The objective is to:
o	Enable individuals to make changes in their behaviour to achieve a positive impact on their health. 
o	Reduce the number of smokers by providing evidence-based treatment and behavioural support to smokers making quit attempts. 
o	Reduce levels of smoking related illness, disability, premature death and health equalities. 
o	Reduce smoking-related health inequalities by increasing access to stop smoking support among routine and manual workers employed in Wolverhampton businesses. 
o	Provide proactive workplace outreach that takes support to employees at times and locations that fit shift patterns, breaks, working hours and operational constraints.
The Key Criteria is a as follows;
Quality and Innovation 60%
Integration, collaboration, and service sustainability 20%
Improving access, reducing health inequalities and facilitating choice	10%
Social Value  10%
Value 0% (Pass / Fail - receipt of compliant commercial matrix)
Offers will be assessed using a one stage 'open' process.

tender.title: Box-Making Machine Replacement

classification.description: Machinery for paper or paperboard production

tender.description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) is seeking to procure the supply, delivery, installation, commissioning and training of a replacement box-making machine, together with associated software, warranty, maintenance and support services. The contract will support NRS's in-house production of archival storage boxes and preservation packaging required to protect and preserve national records.

lots.description:
National Records of Scotland (NRS) is seeking to procure the supply, delivery, installation, commissioning and training of a replacement box-making machine, together with associated software, warranty, maintenance and support services.
The replacement machine is required to replace existing end-of-life equipment and support the continued in-house manufacture of archival storage boxes and preservation packaging used to protect and preserve archive collections. The contract will support NRS's ongoing boxing programme and future collection move activities while improving operational reliability and reducing the risk of service disruption.
The scope of the contract includes the provision of a box-cutting machine capable of cutting, scoring, creasing and processing archival materials used in the production of archival-quality storage boxes and preservation packaging. The successful supplier will be responsible for delivery, installation, commissioning, testing, operator training and the provision of all associated software, tooling and equipment necessary for operation.
The contract will also include warranty, preventative maintenance, software support, technical support and the provision of replacement parts and consumables support arrangements to ensure the ongoing operation and longevity of the solution. Full details of the technical, operational and service requirements are set out within the procurement documentation.
The contract will be awarded to a single supplier responsible for the successful delivery, implementation and support of the complete solution.

renewal.description: Whilst the box-making machine is a one-off capital purchase, the contract includes associated software licensing, maintenance and support services. The contract will be awarded for an initial period of three (3) years, with the option to extend for up to two (2) further periods of twelve (12) months each at the sole discretion of NRS.
